## Declarations and implementations

```plato

//==
// # Hermite curves
//
// The control-point curves whose shape is given by explicit tangents rather than
// by off-curve control points: the single cubic Hermite segment and the
// piecewise spline built from a tangent per knot. Parallel arrays (points +
// tangents) must have equal counts; that invariant is documented rather than
// encoded. Evaluation lives in `splines.library.plato`.
//
// NOT IDeformable2D/3D, unlike every other curve in this file: a tangent is a
// derivative, not a position, and an arbitrary point mapping supplies no image
// for it. Carrying one needs the mapping's linear part, which only an affine
// mapping has — so these types stay outside the Deform surface rather than
// silently leaving their tangents behind.

//==
// # Hermite curves

// A single cubic Hermite segment in the plane: interpolates Start to End with
// the given outgoing and incoming tangents
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cubic_Hermite_spline).
type HermiteCurve2D
    implements ICurve2D
{
    Start: Point2D;
    StartTangent: Vector2D;
    End: Point2D;
    EndTangent: Vector2D;
}

// A single cubic Hermite segment in space: interpolates Start to End with the
// given outgoing and incoming tangents
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cubic_Hermite_spline).
type HermiteCurve3D
    implements ICurve3D
{
    Start: Point3D;
    StartTangent: Vector3D;
    End: Point3D;
    EndTangent: Vector3D;
}

// A piecewise cubic Hermite spline in the plane: interpolates every point with
// an explicit tangent per point (same count as Points). Closed joins the last
// point back to the first
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cubic_Hermite_spline).
type HermiteSpline2D
    implements ICurve2D
{
    Points: Array<Point2D>;
    Tangents: Array<Vector2D>;
    Closed: Boolean;
}

// A piecewise cubic Hermite spline in space: interpolates every point with an
// explicit tangent per point (same count as Points)
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cubic_Hermite_spline).
type HermiteSpline3D
    implements ICurve3D
{
    Points: Array<Point3D>;
    Tangents: Array<Vector3D>;
    Closed: Boolean;
}

//==
// # Interpolating splines
//
// The control-point curves that pass THROUGH every point they are given, with
// tangents derived from the neighbours (Catmull-Rom), shaped per knot
// (Kochanek-Bartels), absent (piecewise linear), or solved for globally (natural
// cubic). Parallel arrays must have equal counts; that invariant is documented
// rather than encoded. Evaluation lives in
// `splines.library.plato`.

//==
// # Interpolating splines

// A Catmull-Rom spline in the plane: interpolates every point with tangents
// derived from neighbors. Alpha selects the parameterization: 0 = uniform,
// 0.5 = centripetal (cusp-free), 1 = chordal
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Centripetal_Catmull%E2%80%93Rom_spline).
type CatmullRomCurve2D
    implements ICurve2D, IDeformable2D
{
    Points: Array<Point2D>;
    Alpha: Number;
    Closed: Boolean;
}

// A Catmull-Rom spline in space: interpolates every point with tangents
// derived from neighbors. Alpha selects the parameterization: 0 = uniform,
// 0.5 = centripetal (cusp-free), 1 = chordal
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Centripetal_Catmull%E2%80%93Rom_spline).
type CatmullRomCurve3D
    implements ICurve3D, IDeformable3D
{
    Points: Array<Point3D>;
    Alpha: Number;
    Closed: Boolean;
}

// A Kochanek-Bartels (TCB) spline in the plane: per-point Tension, Continuity,
// and Bias arrays (same count as Points) shape the tangents at each knot.
// The classic keyframe-animation spline
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kochanek%E2%80%93Bartels_spline).
type TcbSpline2D
    implements ICurve2D, IDeformable2D
{
    Points: Array<Point2D>;
    Tensions: Array<Number>;
    Continuities: Array<Number>;
    Biases: Array<Number>;
    Closed: Boolean;
}

// A Kochanek-Bartels (TCB) spline in space: per-point Tension, Continuity,
// and Bias arrays (same count as Points) shape the tangents at each knot
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kochanek%E2%80%93Bartels_spline).
type TcbSpline3D
    implements ICurve3D, IDeformable3D
{
    Points: Array<Point3D>;
    Tensions: Array<Number>;
    Continuities: Array<Number>;
    Biases: Array<Number>;
    Closed: Boolean;
}

// A piecewise-linear interpolating spline in the plane: the curve-as-function
// view of a chain of points (the geometric chain itself is Polyline2D,
// `polygons.types.plato`). Closed joins the last point back to the first
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polygonal_chain).
type LinearSpline2D
    implements ICurve2D, IDeformable2D
{
    Points: Array<Point2D>;
    Closed: Boolean;
}

// A piecewise-linear interpolating spline in space: the curve-as-function view
// of a chain of points (the geometric chain itself is Polyline3D,
// `polygons.types.plato`)
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polygonal_chain).
type LinearSpline3D
    implements ICurve3D, IDeformable3D
{
    Points: Array<Point3D>;
    Closed: Boolean;
}
```
